prompt: A compound has molecular formula C₆H₁₂. What is its degree of unsaturation (also called hydrogen deficiency index, HDI)?

options.label: 1 (either one ring or one π bond)

explanation: HDI = (2n + 2 − H) / 2 for CₙHₕ. (2·6 + 2 − 12)/2 = 2/2 = 1. One DoU means either a ring OR a π bond. C₆H₁₂ fits cyclohexane (ring) or 1-hexene (π). Rules of thumb: a saturated acyclic CₙH₂ₙ₊₂; each DoU subtracts 2 H.
